subject.title: fix(config): fall back to provider-level contextWindow/maxTokens in model defaults

question: Should the canonical fix inherit only the reported `contextWindow` and `maxTokens` fields, or also activate provider-level `contextTokens` through the competing PR?
rationale: Both branches repair the same compatibility-sensitive defaulting boundary, but they differ on whether an additional documented compatibility field should begin affecting existing configurations in the same release.

options.title: Land the narrow fix
options.body: Merge this PR for the reproduced two-field bug and close the broader competing PR unless `contextTokens` is separately approved.

options.title: Choose the broader fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 if provider-level `contextTokens` should intentionally become effective in the same release, after confirming equivalent invalid-value and normalization coverage.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fix
recommendation.body: Merge this PR for the reproduced two-field bug and close the broader competing PR unless `contextTokens` is separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant provider defaulting contract and central config path appear to originate from and remain heavily maintained by this contributor.
